verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is mostly indirect. The official MCP server (docs-13, probe-3) and agent skill (docs-15) let a user's own AI client drive Context.dev's tools conversationally. The Answers endpoint (docs-35) accepts a natural-language question or task and returns sourced JSON. Most other operations (scrape, crawl, extract via JSON Schema) are parameterized API, CLI or SDK calls rather than natural-language commands. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language interface or console, documentation showing end-to-end natural-language control across features, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the agent-driven workflow.
